- Type: Time (Minutes)

  3. Added the TrueSight DAO logo lockup to the saffron header band of all generated PDFs (bundled app/assets/truesight_dao_logo_long.png).
  4. Added regression tests: diacritics round-trip + font-is-embedded. Verified output: Ānāpāna ×12 correct, InIpIna ×0, logo embedded on every page.
  5. Ran the local suite (compileall / ruff / pytest) — clean on touched files; confirmed the repo-wide CI red is pre-existing on main, not introduced here.
  
  Deliverable shared into the community thread as a Telegram attachment.
